role: Master Systems Architect & Apex Cognitive Agent (BukSU CMS-V2 Orchestrator)
task_description: Comprehensive audit and hardening of Action Done Matrix (Form RU-F-033) synchronity and Secretary Defense Minutes module across Project Proponents (Students), Course Instructors, and Faculty Committee (Adviser, Panelists, Secretary, Chair). Resolved 6 critical architectural and synchronization defects: (1) OCR defense minutes parser now strips BukSU header/footer noise (Document Code, ISO numbers, campus addresses) via isInstitutionalNoiseLine and captures full multi-line paper titles without truncation; (2) Synchronized real-time Socket.IO payloads between server and client ({item, row, actionDoneMatrix, admStatus}) ensuring instant live UI updates without refresh; (3) Added live Socket.IO listeners to SecretaryReviewPage.jsx for live cache invalidation; (4) Patched verifyAdmSignatoryRole in authorize.js to inspect milestone-specific secretary endorsements (admSignaturesByMilestone) preventing premature signature blocking across Capstones 1-4; (5) Hardened RBAC by revoking student access to secretary minutes endpoints and gating mutating toolbar buttons; (6) Replaced hardcoded secretary fallbacks with dynamic institutional names and permitted faculty fallback access when committee assignments are pending in draft projects.

verification_evidence.governance_pipeline: 11 agents valid, DAG verified, 0 errors, 0 warnings

lessons_learned: Lesson: Institutional form OCR parsers (such as BukSU Form OVPAA-F-INS-032) must implement deterministic noise filters (isInstitutionalNoiseLine) to reject pagination, revision codes, and administrative contact footers from bleeding into student/panel remark columns.

Lesson: Socket.IO event payloads between Express controllers and React subscribers must adhere to dual-key symmetry (e.g. providing both 'row' and 'item') to prevent desynchronization between legacy and modern frontend hooks.

Lesson: Multi-phase capstone sign-offs must verify milestone-specific endorsements (admSignaturesByMilestone[milestone].secretary.endorsed) rather than global project flags to enable independent progression across Capstones 1, 2, 3, and 4.
